integrity: Analytic proof gives the infinite-family identity; two independent finite enumerators and a matching recursion validate the cuboctahedral instance. Historical equivalence cannot be fully excluded.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple cubic three-edge-colorable bases; exactly three spin values; uniform positive antiferromagnetic coupling; single-color field; zero temperature. No finite-temperature or bulk-phase-transition claim.
title: Universal magnetic plateaux and matching-polynomial coexistence for the three-state Potts antiferromagnet on cubic line graphs
